'''''First Film''''' is a 2008 superhero film.

===Box office===
''First Film'' grossed $319&nbsp;million in the United States and Canada, and $266.8&nbsp;million in other territories, for a worldwide total of $585.8&nbsp;million.<ref name="BOM" /> ''[[Reuters]]'' reported that the film's production budget was around $140&nbsp;million with another $75&nbsp;million for marketing costs.<ref name="Budget" />

In its opening weekend, ''First Film'' grossed $98.6&nbsp;million in 4,105 theaters in the United States and Canada, ranking first at the box office.<ref name="mojo" />
